name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly find recycling facilities in their vicinity by searching with a zip code and viewing their locations on a map.
The User seeks to view operational hours, types of waste accepted, and other relevant details for each recycling facility.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and public recycling bins in their area.
The User wants to create an account, save favorite facilities, and potentially receive recommendations based on their schedule and waste types.
The User aims to easily contact administrators for feedback, questions, or assistance regarding the application or recycling services.
The User expects their personal information, including credentials, to be securely stored and managed within the application to prevent identity theft or harassment.
The Administrator aims to add new recycling facilities to the platform and remove outdated or incorrect facility information to maintain an accurate database.
The Administrator seeks to read and categorize user feedback and complaints to identify areas for service improvement and new feature development.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain direct communication channels with recycling facility representatives to update them on features and address concerns.
The Facility Representative aims to independently update their facility's details, such as accepted materials and operational hours, to ensure accuracy for users.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct channel to communicate any problems or concerns they have with the site administrators for resolution.
The Superuser aims to have the authority to update recycling center information, ensuring the latest details are available to users.
The Superuser seeks to answer user questions related to recycling centers, providing timely and accurate information.
The Company aims to manage and update the content and features of the website, including uploading and deleting information, to ensure it remains current and relevant.
lowLevelGoals: The system should enable users to enter a zip code to initiate a search for recycling facilities within that area.
The system should present the locations of found recycling facilities on a map interface, allowing users to visually identify them.
Alongside the map, the system should offer a list displaying the names and addresses of the recycling facilities found.
The system should allow users to select a specific facility from the map or list to access a dedicated page with more details.
The system should present the opening and closing times for the chosen recycling facility.
The system should clearly enumerate the categories of recyclable materials that the chosen facility accepts.
The system should display phone numbers, email addresses, or website links for the chosen facility.
The system should provide a clickable address for each facility that, when activated, launches Google Maps with the facility's location.
The system should provide an option for users to opt-in to receive alerts about upcoming recycling events.
The system should automatically dispatch alerts to subscribed users when new recycling events are announced.
The system should inform users about temporary or specialized locations for dropping off specific types of waste.
The system should provide notifications regarding the availability and locations of public recycling bins.
The system should provide a registration process for users to create an account with their credentials.
The system should provide a feature for logged-in users to mark and store preferred recycling facilities for quick access.
The system should suggest relevant recycling facilities to users based on their saved preferences, location, and waste types.
The system should provide a form for users to submit comments, suggestions, or report issues to administrators.
The system should offer a clear way for users to reach out for support, such as an email address or a helpdesk link.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to input and save details for new recycling facilities.
The system should allow administrators to delete outdated or incorrect recycling facility information from the database.
The system should provide functionality for administrators to modify information such as addresses, hours, and accepted materials for existing facilities.
The system should present a centralized interface where administrators can see all submitted user feedback and complaints.
The system should allow administrators to assign categories (e.g., bug report, feature request) and tags to feedback for easier organization.
The system should provide status tracking for feedback items, enabling administrators to manage their workflow.
The system should offer a private communication channel for administrators to interact with facility representatives.
The system should allow administrators to broadcast information about new features or policy changes to all relevant facility representatives.
The system should provide a secure login for facility representatives to access their specific management tools.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the opening and closing times of their facility.
The system should provide a mechanism for facility representatives to add or remove accepted waste categories for their facility.
The system should offer a secure channel for facility representatives to send messages directly to site administrators.
The system should provide a structured way for facility representatives to submit problem reports or express concerns.
The system should grant superusers the ability to modify all details of any recycling center listed on the platform.
The system should provide a workflow for superusers to review and decide on changes submitted by facility representatives or administrators.
The system should display a centralized list of all questions submitted by users.
The system should provide a text editor and sending mechanism for superusers to respond to user questions.
The system should provide a status update feature for superusers to track the resolution of user questions.
The system should provide an interface for company representatives to add new articles, images, or other informational content.
The system should provide functionality for company representatives to remove outdated or irrelevant content from the website.
The system should provide tools for company representatives to edit and modify current website content.
The system should provide controls for company representatives to activate or deactivate various functionalities or sections of the website.
The system should enable users to choose one or more waste categories (e.g., plastic, glass, paper) to narrow down the search results for recycling facilities.
The system should provide a feature for users to input or upload their recurring recycling schedule (e.g., days of the week, preferred times) to receive tailored recommendations.
The system should offer options for users to specify preferred time windows for recycling pickups, accommodating their availability.
The system should process user-provided schedules and waste types to suggest suitable recycling facilities.
The system should calculate and display the most efficient travel route to one or more chosen recycling facilities.
The system should show the geographical locations of public recycling bins on a map interface.
The system should present the locations of temporary or specialized waste drop-off sites on a map interface.
The system should show the locations and details of upcoming safe disposal events on a map interface.
The system should track user recycling activities (e.g., facility visits, scheduled pickups) and award points accordingly.
The system should provide a dashboard or section where users can see their current reward point balance.
The system should provide a catalog of rewards (e.g., discounts, vouchers) that users can exchange their accumulated points for.
